_units.postfx_haze_drift: patches per s the haze drifts across the glass

_units.postfx_rain_blur_radius: share of the view's height over which the fully blurred view is smeared
_units.postfx_rain_blur_center: weight of the middle of the smear among its five taps, 0 to 1 (the four around it share the rest)

_units.postfx_rain_streak_speed: view heights per s the rain falls

_units.postfx_rain_streak_far: how many times larger and faster the second layer of streaks is than the first
_units.postfx_crack_center: where on the windscreen the web of cracks is centred, the point of impact: share across from the driver's side, share up (before his eyes, and all of the web on the glass)

_units.postfx_crack_core: share of the web's reach, from the point of impact, over which the crushed glass thins out
_units.postfx_crack_fray: share of the web's reach over which it frays out at its rim: a shard ends up to half of it short of the reach or past it
_units.postfx_glare_radius: share of the view's height from the light at which the wash has faded to about a third

_units.postfx_cabin_darkness_share: share of the darkness that falls on the cabin (the dashboard glows), 0 to 1
